Deck.title: Modifier Deck
Deck.reshufflePending: A Critical or Null was drawn: the deck will be reshuffled at the end of the round
Deck.rebuildConfirm: Rebuild this Modifier Deck from the base deck and your ticked perks? The discard pile is shuffled back in. Bless and Curse cards are kept.
Deck.notReady: This Modifier Deck has not been created yet. A GM must be connected to create it.

Draw.tie: Both cards are equivalent but differ in effects: the GM decides which one applies.

Test.title: Attribute Test
Test.bonusHint: Skill bonus (half its level, rounded up) and other modifiers.
Test.resistBackgroundHint: Resisting costs a Background, which gives no bonus here.

Attack.title: Attack
Attack.bonusHint: Sum of +X / -X attack effects (e.g. +1 if the target is Poisoned).
Attack.wardHint: Halves the damage, rounding the reduction up. Applied last, after Shield.
Attack.poisonedHint: +1 attack, applied with the other attack bonuses.

Rest.title: Rest
Rest.quickBreathHint: End of scene: recover expended powers and Backgrounds, and remove conditions.
Rest.fullRestHint: Recover all HP, all powers and Backgrounds, and remove conditions and Bless/Curse cards.

Notify.noGM: A GM must be connected to do this.
Notify.notDeckOwner: You do not own this Modifier Deck.
Notify.deckEmpty: Not enough cards in the Modifier Deck.

cardFace.name: Modifier card faces
cardFace.hint: How modifier cards are displayed for you: Gloomhaven-style faces, or the matching playing card (for groups using a poker deck).

Perk.none: No perks yet. Add one and enter its cards from your class's perk list.
Perk.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Replace a −1 with a +0 Wound
Perk.codesHint: Each box below is one checkbox of the perk. Write cards as playing-card codes: 7♥ or 7H, 10S, AC, RJ / BJ for jokers. Separate several cards with spaces or +.

issue.invalidCode: {perk} (box {box}): "{code}" is not a valid card code.
issue.missingCard: {perk} (box {box}): {code} is not in the deck, so it can't be removed.
issue.duplicateCard: {perk} (box {box}): {code} is already in the deck. Groups using a poker deck can't have it twice.

import.title: Import perks
import.hint: Choose a JSON file of perks (one class file, for example). Perks whose name already exists on this mercenary are skipped.

Condition.resist: Resist: test this Attribute, expending a Background (it gives no bonus). TN = the enemy's move + attack.

bless.name: Bless
bless.hint: Shuffles a Bless card into the Modifier Deck (max 6). It counts as a Critical.

curse.name: Curse
curse.hint: Shuffles a Curse card into the Modifier Deck (max 6). It counts as a Null. Test UN to resist.

invisible.name: Invisible
invisible.hint: Enemies can't target you, and opposing tokens (Friendly vs Hostile) can't see your token. Combat: until the end of your next turn. Exploration: until the end of the scene.

regenerate.name: Regenerate
regenerate.hint: Heal 1 at the start of each of your turns, before Wound. Lasts until you take damage.

safeguard.name: Safeguard
safeguard.hint: Prevents the next negative condition you would gain.

strengthen.name: Strengthen
strengthen.hint: Your actions gain advantage. Combat: until the end of your next turn. Exploration: one action.

ward.name: Ward
ward.hint: Halves the next damage you suffer (reduction rounded up), applied after everything else.

immobilize.name: Immobilize
immobilize.hint: You can't perform movement abilities (forced movement still works). Combat: until the end of your next turn. Test FI to resist.

muddle.name: Muddle
muddle.hint: Your actions gain disadvantage. Combat: until the end of your next turn. Test LO to resist.

pacify.name: Pacify
pacify.hint: You can't perform attack abilities. Combat: until the end of your next turn. Test IN to resist.

poison.name: Poison
poison.hint: Attacks targeting you gain +1 attack. Lasts until you are healed (the heal only removes Poison) or the scene ends. Test CU to resist.

stun.name: Stun
stun.hint: You can't use items or perform any abilities. Combat: until the end of your next turn. Test GR to resist (instead of an action).

wound.name: Wound
wound.hint: Suffer 1 damage at the start of each of your turns (every minute in exploration). Lasts until healed or the scene ends. Test GR to resist.

unconscious.name: Unconscious
unconscious.hint: At 0 HP: you can't act until healed or a Full Rest.
